snippet.title: Veil of Ashes | RTT Game | Early Development Gameplay
snippet.description:
In this video we show you a 2vs2 multiplayer match in our prototype. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511540?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=organic
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/JrNYJ8Qsww
Website: https://greifenmaer.com/veil-of-ashes
Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@veilofashesgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/veilofashesgame/

Compared to the trailer, it quickly becomes apparent that elements such as infantry or airdrops are still missing. Features such as the fundamental resource system are already implemented.
We developed the prototype as a technical basis and look and feel to test our concept. At the same time, the prototype has been developed in such a way that we can continue to build on it seamlessly.
